answer.conclusion:
I called spawn_agent exactly twice, and both child runs aborted on environment blockers, so there is no Child A / Child B pair and therefore no cross-agent conflict result to report. Because the two-agent structure is the point of the task, treat this as unfulfilled orchestration; the three facts below were computed and checked by me directly instead, and all three hold. Child A never ran: with network and write allowed the child was routed to Execute mode and failed with "no provider route for mode Execute". What is verified, by a real arithmetic run and not by self-assessment, is this set.

|---|---|---|
| 42 = 2 × 3 × 7, a product of three distinct primes (sphenic) | prime-factorisation loop | factors [2,3,7], 3 distinct — holds |

A fourth, commonly quoted item — that 42 is Douglas Adams's "answer to the ultimate question of life, the universe and everything" — could not be sourced: the Wikipedia fetch failed and the web search returned only perfume-retailer pages, so it is left out of the verified set rather than asserted. Next action: enable a provider route for child Execute mode (or tell me which of the two spawn configurations your environment supports), and I will re-run the exact A/B split and do the real conflict comparison.
